name: Cal/OSHA Pressure Vessel Registration Database (air tanks, boilers, LPG tanks)
publisher: Dept. of Industrial Relations, Division of Occupational Safety and Health, Pressure Vessel Unit
signal_type: installed compressed-air receivers by site; new permits to operate
what_it_tells_you: California requires a Permit to Operate for air tanks (8 CCR 461), and DIR publishes a searchable database of permit and inspection activity for all steam boilers, air tanks and LPG tanks. Search by company, address, city, county, ZIP, state number or expiry. Results: state number, inspection agency, permit expiry, inspection date, company, street, city, ZIP, county, year built, MAWP psi, National Board number, serial number, manufacturer name, diameter, location in plant, owner type. State numbers for vessels first inspected after 2018 carry the year (format A18-001234), so new registrations may be listable by year prefix (untested).

lead_time_months: 0 (coincident: tank is installed) but a direct count of receivers per site and their age; expiring permits flag 5-year re-inspection cycles
application_received_date_exposed: no (inspection date and permit expiry only)
update_cadence: 'date last updated' field per record; cadence not stated
last_updated_confirmed: Page live 2026-11-10; no dated record viewed
access_method: web query form; no download offered
automation_notes: Query form only; conditions of use not read. Treat as manual lookup until terms are read.
coverage_notes: Statewide, all industries. Exemptions for small tanks (under 1.5 cu ft and under 150 psi safety valve setting per secondary sources). Insurance inspectors also file, so coverage should be broad.
verification_notes: DIR pressure vessel page and database form page fetched 2026-11-10; no live query run, so result fields are from the form's own description.
